name: Repeated wins by the same supplier with narrow margins
description: One supplier repeatedly wins just below competitors or in rotation among a small group.
fp: May have innocent explanations; assess in context of customer profile and other indicators.

sources.text: OECD, Recommendation of the Council on Public Procurement (2015)
OECD, Preventing Corruption in Public Procurement (2016)
OECD, Guidelines for Fighting Bid Rigging in Public Procurement (2009)
FATF, Laundering the Proceeds of Corruption (2011)

links.name: Repeated wins by the same supplier with narrow margins
links.ctx: One supplier repeatedly wins just below competitors or in rotation among a small group.
links.fp: Niche markets may have few capable bidders.
